title: ResolvedReleaseTheme
description: Shared, versioned contract for a release's resolved theme tokens. DEMU (this repo) produces documents against this schema in the `myradio:theme-config` feed tag; MYRADIO's release-theme resolver validates incoming theme-config against the same schema before applying it. Both repos must keep an identical copy of this file — see the checksum test in tests/int/release-theme-schema.int.spec.ts, which fails if this file changes without a deliberate, coordinated update on both sides. Bump `themeSchemaVersion` whenever the token set or its meaning changes in a way older clients cannot safely ignore.

themeSchemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to. A client that does not understand this version must fall back to the named theme preset plus release/track artwork, per EO §7.8.

hexColor.description: 6-digit hex color, or 8-digit with alpha. Absent/omitted means inherit the named theme preset for this token — this schema never requires all 18 tokens, only that any token present is well-formed.
